connector.name: Synapse - GEO Growth Layer
connector.registryDescription: Lints + auto-fixes how AI coding agents discover any new product. 24 rules, 6 tools, score 0-100.
connector.summary: Hosted at runsynapse.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the calvinling2021-star account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SYNAPSE_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Required only for geo_fix and geo_track_init tools. Read-only tools work without a key.

env.name: SYNAPSE_BACKEND
env.description: Override the Synapse backend URL. Defaults to https://runsynapse.dev.
